name: database-sentinel
description: Security audits for Supabase and MongoDB: the audit skill plus read-only Supabase MCP tools.

supabase_dsn.title: Read-only connection string
supabase_dsn.description: postgresql://sentinel_auditor:<password>@db.<ref>.supabase.co:5432/postgres (Supabase only; create the role first: docs/mcp.md step 1)

supabase_url.title: Supabase project URL
supabase_url.description: https://<ref>.supabase.co (optional; lets Sentinel check what anonymous users can read)

supabase_anon_key.title: Supabase anon key
supabase_anon_key.description: The public anon key, never the service-role key (optional, used with the project URL)

app_repo.title: App source folder
app_repo.description: Your app's code, scanned for leaked keys (optional)
